about_the_game:
Story

Everyone has been naive at some point in life. As children, we explored the world with curiosity, not knowing what was safe or dangerous. It was a time of learning, where mistakes were part of the journey. Being naive is a natural step in discovering life’s wonders.

And so was this little panda, who fell into a big, ancient cave, while exploring the wilderness. Guide him through an uncharted underground world, as you race against time and master all challenges to rescue him from the depths of an ancient, forgotten cave.

Gameplay

Bamboozled! - Rise or Fall is a challenging precision platformer with some extra spice:

  • Get to the top and save the panda

  • Master all challenges of the cave

  • Manage to reach the next Angels monument before time runs out

  • Discover the cave's mystery

short_description: Bamboozled! - Rise or Fall appears to be a cozy game about a panda. But don’t be fooled, every jump could send you back to the start. Guide the brave panda through an uncharted underground world, as you race against time and master all challenges to rescue him from the depths of an ancient cave.
